model_checks.scope: Fixed original model state and one CPU input per model; no whole-model equivalence claim.

methodology: Counts are physical source lines from the frozen original and bound candidate inventories, excluding tests and local state.

Original capability counts include all original descendants; candidate counts include explicitly mapped own files and retained descendants. Excluded descendants do not require candidate mapping. Shared files count once within a node; node counts cannot be added together.
Candidate ownership is explicitly supplied metadata, not proof of semantic ownership. Missing mappings remain unknown, never zero or a claimed reduction.
Function steps inherit their owning capability's code scope and validation; they are not independently measured or tested.
Verification describes declared check groups and their observed configurations, not individual unit-test counts or full semantic equivalence.
Failed original baselines, unrun checks, retired scope and incomplete coverage remain distinct. Installation is reported separately.
Only public labels, relative file mappings, hashes and summary observations are included. Source contents, command argv, environment values and captured output are omitted.
Evidence comes from an independent frozen-upstream-test audit. Native harness execution readiness was blocked by incomplete coverage; no native verification-success record is claimed.

All selected graph capabilities remain required; selected scope and mapped source do not establish that every capability is implemented. Nodes with passing mapped cases remain partial because complete functional coverage is not established.

Fixed-original-state model checks are separate from upstream-test denominators. Their failures mark the explicitly associated pipeline capabilities and ancestors failed; a passing one-input observation can support only partial coverage.
A red node means an associated check failed, not that the fault was localized to that module. Import associations and shared tests are not full feature coverage.
Individual test counts, executed pass rates and coverage are recorded separately in verification-detail.json. Tests are associated using direct imports; this does not establish full module behavior.
